_comment: Synthetic provider records keyed by NPI. npi_lookup reads this file and never calls the network, so the demo path works with no internet. Every NPI here deliberately fails the CMS check digit (Luhn over '80840' + the 9-digit base), so none of them can ever be issued by CMS or resolve to a real practitioner. Verified: 1234567890 requires check digit 3 and carries 0.
